rationale: The stock gapped up ~13% from prior close with no news catalyst identified, which creates significant uncertainty about the driver and sustainability of the move. Price is at 75% of today's range with the last candle showing a sharp spike to $90.59 on very high volume (47K shares in 1 minute), suggesting a potential exhaustion move near the high — but the wide bid-ask spread (56 bps) and lack of news context make it difficult to assess whether this is a breakout continuation or a fade setup. Without a clear catalyst and with the spread eating into any edge, the risk/reward is insufficient to justify entry in either direction.
